Language: en

PHeReferralImplementationGuide

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

urn://example.com/ph-ereferral/fhir/ImplementationGuide/fhir.ph.ereferral

This implementation guide is provided to support the use of FHIR®© in an Philippines context, and defines the minimum set of constraints on the FHIR resources to create the PH eReferral profiles. This implementation guide forms the foundation to build future PH Realm FHIR implementation guides and its content will continue to grow to meet the needs of PH implementers.

name: PHeReferralImplementationGuide
title: PH eReferral Implementation Guide
description: This implementation guide is provided to support the use of FHIR®© in an Philippines context, and defines the minimum set of constraints on the FHIR resources to create the PH eReferral profiles. This implementation guide forms the foundation to build future PH Realm FHIR implementation guides and its content will continue to grow to meet the needs of PH implementers.

resource.name: ERefEncounter
resource.description: Encounter profile for the Philippine eReferral system. Extends PHCoreEncounter to capture the clinical encounter context associated with a referral, including encounter status, classification, participants, and clinical information relevant to the referral workflow.

resource.name: EReferral MedicationAdministration
resource.description: Profile for medications administered to patients in the Philippine eReferral context. Captures medications given as part of treatment (REF-39) and referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo (REF-15) to provide clinical context for referrals.

resource.name: EReferral Observation
resource.description:
Profile for clinical observations in the Philippine eReferral context. 
Supports vital signs, laboratory results, and clinical measurements included in 
referral clinical summaries. Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo and 
ServiceRequest.reasonReference.

resource.name: eReferral Priority
resource.description: Priority levels for eReferral requests. Uses standard FHIR RequestPriority values.

resource.name: EReferral Provenance
resource.description: Profile for tracking audit trail of eReferral actions including signatures and timestamps in the Philippine eReferral context.

resource.name: eReferral Reason
resource.description: Clinical reasons for eReferral requests. Uses SNOMED CT clinical findings and diagnoses.

resource.name: eReferral Receiving Facility Response
resource.description: Response states used by a receiving facility after referral receipt in the PH eReferral workflow.

resource.name: EReferral RelatedPerson
resource.description: RelatedPerson profile for the Philippine eReferral system. This profile represents optional patient contacts used in referral workflows, including next of kin, emergency contacts, accompanying persons, and guardians. It extends PHCoreRelatedPerson and maps to TDG element REF-29.

resource.name: eReferral Relationship Type
resource.description: Relationship roles used for patient contacts, next of kin, emergency contacts, guardians, and accompanying persons in Philippine eReferral.

resource.name: eReferral Service Category
resource.description: Categories of services that can be requested through eReferral

resource.name: EReferral ServiceRequest
resource.description: Profile for ServiceRequest resource in the Philippine eReferral context. This profile defines the core referral request structure for referring patients between healthcare facilities.

resource.name: EReferral Task
resource.description: Task profile for Philippine eReferral workflow management. Tracks referral state transitions from request through completion, supporting workflow coordination between sending and receiving facilities.

resource.name: eReferral Workflow Code System
resource.description: Local workflow codes for Philippine eReferral receiving-facility responses and related referral coordination events.

resource.name: ERefImmunization
resource.description: Immunization profile for the Philippine eReferral system. Extends PHCoreImmunization to define must-support elements for referral clinical context. Immunization records are referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo to provide supporting clinical information about a patient's vaccination history.

resource.name: ERefImmunization Example - Routine Immunization (MMR)
resource.description: Example immunization instance demonstrating routine vaccination (MMR - Measles-Mumps-Rubella) as supporting clinical information in an eReferral context via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

resource.name: ERefPatient
resource.description: Patient profile for the Philippine eReferral system. Extends PHCorePatient with additional elements specific to referral workflows, including PWD (Person with Disability) registration information. This profile supports the patient demographic requirements defined in the eReferral TDG (Technical Development Group) mapping, elements REF-21 through REF-30.

resource.name: ERefPatient Example - Juan Dela Cruz
resource.description: Example patient instance demonstrating the ERefPatient profile with PhilHealth ID, PhilSys ID, PWD registration, and complete demographic information for eReferral.

resource.name: Example Antibiotic Administration
resource.description: Example IV antibiotic administration for a patient with suspected infection. Demonstrates REF-39 Treatment Given data element.

resource.name: Example Blood Pressure Observation
resource.description: Example blood pressure vital sign for eReferral (REF-33). Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

resource.name: Example Body Temperature Observation
resource.description: Example body temperature vital sign for eReferral (REF-37). Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

resource.name: Example Body Weight Observation
resource.description: Example body weight vital sign for eReferral (REF-38). Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

resource.name: Example Cefuroxime Medication
resource.description: Example antibiotic medication resource for IV administration.

resource.name: Example Chief Complaint Observation
resource.description: Example chief complaint for eReferral (REF-31). Referenced via ServiceRequest.reasonReference to provide clinical context for referral.

resource.name: Example Chronic Medication Administration
resource.description: Example chronic medication administration (antihypertensive) demonstrating routine medication given to patient. Part of clinical summary (REF-15).

resource.name: Example Condition - Chest Pain
resource.description: Example chest pain condition for referral

resource.name: Example ECG Observation
resource.description: Example ECG findings observation for eReferral. Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo for cardiac referrals.

resource.name: Example eReferral Encounter
resource.description: An example encounter for a cardiology referral, where a patient is received at a tertiary hospital based on a referral from a rural health unit.

resource.name: Example eReferral Patient
resource.description: Example patient for eReferral demonstration

resource.name: Example eReferral Patient (for Task)
resource.description: Minimal patient instance for ERefTask demonstration.

resource.name: Example eReferral Patient (Minimal)
resource.description: Minimal patient instance for Provenance demonstration.

resource.name: Example eReferral Provenance for Status Update
resource.description: Provenance record documenting a referral status update without signature. Demonstrates REF-3 (Date & Time of activity).

resource.name: Example eReferral Provenance with Signature
resource.description: Provenance record demonstrating professional signature attestation for a referral. Demonstrates REF-3 (Date & Time of Signature) and REF-4 (Professional Signature).

resource.name: Example eReferral Service Request
resource.description: An example referral request from a rural health unit to a tertiary hospital for cardiology consultation.

resource.name: Example eReferral Service Request (Minimal)
resource.description: Minimal service request instance for Provenance demonstration.

resource.name: Example eReferral Task - Accepted State
resource.description: Task representing an eReferral that has been accepted by the receiving facility. Demonstrates TDG REF-9 'Care Navigator' assignment with owner now populated.

resource.name: Example eReferral Task - Completed State
resource.description: Task representing a completed eReferral. Demonstrates full workflow closure with execution period and completion output.

resource.name: Example eReferral Task - Received State
resource.description: Task representing an eReferral acknowledged by the receiving facility and under review for acceptance.

resource.name: Example eReferral Task - Referred Onward State
resource.description: Task representing an eReferral response where the receiving facility cannot take the case and directs the referral to another facility.

resource.name: Example eReferral Task - Rejected State
resource.description: Task representing an eReferral response where the receiving facility cannot take the case and no onward facility is specified.

resource.name: Example eReferral Task - Requested State
resource.description: Task representing a newly created eReferral in 'requested' status. Demonstrates TDG REF-9 'Care Navigator' assignment pattern with requester populated but owner not yet assigned.

resource.name: Example ERefRelatedPerson - Accompanying Person
resource.description: Example accompanying person for an eReferral patient.

resource.name: Example ERefRelatedPerson - Next of Kin
resource.description: Example next-of-kin RelatedPerson for an eReferral patient.

resource.name: Example Heart Rate Observation
resource.description: Example heart rate vital sign for eReferral (REF-34). Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

resource.name: Example Laboratory Glucose Observation
resource.description: Example laboratory result observation for eReferral with reference range.

resource.name: Example Onward eReferral ServiceRequest
resource.description: ServiceRequest representing the onward referral created after the first receiving facility reports that capacity is full.

resource.name: Example Onward Receiving Facility (for Task)
resource.description: Organization instance representing the alternate receiving facility for a referred-onward response.

resource.name: Example Oxygen Saturation Observation
resource.description: Example oxygen saturation vital sign for eReferral (REF-36). Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

resource.name: Example Receiving Facility (for Task)
resource.description: Organization instance representing the receiving tertiary hospital.

resource.name: Example Receiving Hospital
resource.description: Example tertiary hospital receiving facility

resource.name: Example Referring Facility
resource.description: Example referring healthcare facility for the Philippines eReferral workflow.

resource.name: Example Referring Facility (for Task)
resource.description: Minimal organization instance representing the referring facility.

resource.name: Example Referring Facility (Minimal)
resource.description: Minimal organization instance for Provenance demonstration.

resource.name: Example Referring Practitioner
resource.description: Example referring practitioner demonstrating practitioner demographics for the Philippines eReferral workflow.

resource.name: Example Referring Practitioner (for Task)
resource.description: Minimal practitioner instance for ERefTask demonstration.

resource.name: Example Referring Practitioner (Minimal)
resource.description: Minimal practitioner instance for Provenance demonstration.

resource.name: Example Referring Practitioner Role
resource.description: Example referring practitioner role linking practitioner to facility for the Philippines eReferral workflow.

resource.name: Example Referring Practitioner Role (for Task)
resource.description: Practitioner role linking referring practitioner to their facility.

resource.name: Example Referring Practitioner Role (Minimal)
resource.description: Minimal practitioner role instance for Provenance demonstration.

resource.name: Example Respiratory Rate Observation
resource.description: Example respiratory rate vital sign for eReferral (REF-35). Referenced via ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

resource.name: Example ServiceRequest (for Task)
resource.description: Minimal ServiceRequest instance referenced by Task examples.

resource.name: Example Twinact Medication
resource.description: Example medication resource for Twinact (Telmisartan + Amlodipine) used in chronic medication administration example.

resource.name: PH eReferral PractitionerRole
resource.description: Profile on PractitionerRole for the Philippines eReferral specification, extending PHCorePractitionerRole. This profile captures the role of the referring practitioner and care navigator within the eReferral workflow, linking practitioners to healthcare facilities.

resource.name: PWD Disability Registration
resource.description: Extension for Person With Disability (PWD) registration information in the Philippine eReferral system. Captures PWD ID number, disability type, and ID expiration date.

resource.name: PWD Disability Type Code System
resource.description: Code system for types of disability as defined by the Philippine government for PWD registration.

resource.name: PWD Disability Type Value Set
resource.description: Value set for types of disability as defined by the Philippine government for PWD registration.
